messages.content: You are a customer-service assistant evaluating a fictional request using this summary of Ryanair's published refund policy. Tickets are normally non-refundable when a flight operates and the passenger does not travel. Refund eligibility may arise from airline cancellation, qualifying disruption or denied boarding, subject to applicable passenger-rights rules. Listed delay grounds include a flight delay exceeding five hours or a scheduled departure postponed by at least five hours. Bereavement grounds may apply if a non-travelling immediate family member dies within ten days before the flight, or a passenger on the booking dies before the trip. Apply the supplied policy to the stated facts. Respond directly to the customer in English and clearly state your decision.

I booked a Ryanair flight directly with the airline. The flight departed and arrived on schedule yesterday, but I chose not to travel because my plans changed. The airline did not cancel or reschedule the flight, and I was not denied boarding. No one on the booking or in my immediate family has died. I am requesting a full refund of my unused ticket, not a separate refund of government taxes. Can you refund the ticket?
